item: Reference run: a text-encoding error is recorded by its class alone, never its message
summary: Found by the coordinator's check of another PR: an environment value the locale cannot encode (a passphrase-file letter) makes Popen raise a UnicodeEncodeError whose message names the letter and its offset, which the exact-match scrub cannot recognise, so it reached report reason. Both the phase-start handler and the runner's outer handler now record a UnicodeError by class with a fixed note (_exc_text); one test per site fails without the change.
